Overview
The Acme Widget is a modular fastening system for industrial shelving. This guide walks a technician through unpacking, mounting and first-use checks. Read the safety section before starting work.
Safety Precautions
Always disconnect mains power before opening the housing. The widget carries residual charge for up to two minutes after shutdown.
Wear insulated gloves rated to 1000 V
Keep the work area dry at all times
Never bypass the interlock switch

Maintenance Schedule
Inspect the fastening ring every six months. Replace the gasket kit whenever the housing is opened.
Warranty is void if the unit is operated outside the rated temperature envelope.
For spare parts, quote the serial number printed on the base plate when contacting Acme support.
